email.subject1: a signal play for Smith Micro
email.body1:
Mark, saw Smith Micro launched SafePath OS for Senior Phone, opening up the underserved senior segment for carriers.

A new carrier-facing product usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before momentum fades, and that gap is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Smith Micro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mark, quick follow-up for Smith Micro.

With the senior-phone launch, the carrier target list grows faster than headcount can. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings each rep needs to convert that demand, so the gap surfaces late in the quarter when it is hardest to fix.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Smith Micro needs to hit target this quarter without hiring a wave of reps.
email.body3:

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Smith Micro's reply rate likely compares to other software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
